# Poe2WorldState

[API index](../index)

Access to the latest PoE2 state refreshed by game managers plus script-facing actions.

Rust seam: this is a cheap handle over [`Poe2Game`] rather than a game-owned object, so creating it
does not introduce an `Rc` cycle. Each accessor delegates back to manager-owned live state.

## Area

```typescript
Area: Poe2AreaAccessor;
```

Current area facts.


Canonical player state and event timestamps.

## IsInPeacefulArea

```typescript
IsInPeacefulArea: boolean | null;
```

Whether the current area is a town or hideout; null when area data is unavailable.
This classification does not detect nearby enemies or whether combat is occurring.

**@keywords**

area, peaceful, town, hideout, combat

## InTown

```typescript
InTown: boolean;
```

True when the current area is known to be a town. Unknown area data returns false.

**@keywords**

area, town, condition, guard

## NotInTown

```typescript
NotInTown: boolean;
```

True when the current area is known not to be a town. Unknown area data returns false.

**@keywords**

area, town, condition, guard

## InHideout

```typescript
InHideout: boolean;
```

True when the current area is known to be a hideout. Unknown area data returns false.

**@keywords**

area, hideout, condition, guard

## NotInHideout

```typescript
NotInHideout: boolean;
```

True when the current area is known not to be a hideout. Unknown area data returns false.

**@keywords**

area, hideout, condition, guard

## InPeacefulArea

```typescript
InPeacefulArea: boolean;
```

True when the current area is known to be peaceful. Unknown area data returns false.
Peaceful means town or hideout, not an absence of nearby enemies.

**@keywords**

area, peaceful, condition, guard

## NotInPeacefulArea

```typescript
NotInPeacefulArea: boolean;
```

True when the current area is known not to be peaceful. Unknown area data returns false.
This means neither town nor hideout; it is not a separate combat-zone flag or a check for combat.
Prefer this guard to negating IsInPeacefulArea, whose null value would also pass negation.

**@keywords**

area, combat, peaceful, guard

## MousePosition

```typescript
MousePosition: Vector2;
```

Current world cursor in grid units, using the same source as entity cursor geometry.
Returns the zero vector when no game area is available.

**@keywords**

cursor, mouse, targeting, grid, position

